extractions.quote: The basis on which the authors made the SPSD diagnosis — i.e. what they relied on to reach the diagnosis. Many of these papers are old and do NOT use a formal/published criteria set, so do not look for or invent a named criteria. Instead: if the paper lists the specific findings that pointed to the diagnosis (e.g. clinical features such as stiffness/spasms/ hyperlordosis, positive antibodies such as anti-GAD, EMG showing continuous motor-unit activity, response to benzodiazepines), list all of them.
